source.title: Open problems in the theory of scheduling

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH record 2156264 from the original URL.

Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/2156264 returned a blocked_or_challenged Cloudflare 403 page. The zbMATH API returned resolver metadata for Gerhard J. Woeginger, title 'Open problems in the theory of scheduling', source 'Current Trends in Theoretical Computer Science', World Scientific, 2004, pages 19-38, with no full-text links.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempted zbMATH metadata, exact-title searches with PDF and author terms, EATCS bulletin archive paths, DBLP, University of Twente and Eindhoven research portal pages, Google Books/World Scientific book pages, ISBN 9789812387837 pages, and a third-party mirror. University, DBLP, bookstore, and catalog pages were metadata or table-of-contents only; EATCS beatcs76.pdf paths returned 404 or redirected to current issue pages; Google Books exposed only preview/snippet access through available tooling rather than readable full technical text; the third-party mirror marked the file unavailable. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source artifact was recovered.

Source adequacy gate failed. Extraction was not performed because resolver metadata, abstracts, table-of-contents entries, search snippets, and Google Books snippets cannot serve as technical evidence for accepted questions.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-2156264.json and outputs/latest.json.
